To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structure of the obese hormone, leptin, has been solved and that the structure reveals a four helix bundle similar to that seen in the long chain helical cytokine superfamily.

1) the crystal structure of the mutant OB protein leptin-E100 reveals a four-helical bundle similar to the long chain helical cytokine superfamily; 2) the structure shows a hydrophobic pocket at the dimer interface that is a potential binding site for OB-R; and 3) the structure shows that the Cys-96-Cys-190 disulfide bond is critical for the formation of the four-helix bundle.
the crystal structure of the long-chain cytokine leptin is a four-helix-bundle, and that it is similar to other long-chain cytokines.
